mapper.sql: select u.user_id,p.employee_no,coalesce(p.phone_country_code, case when vietnam.dept_id is not null then '+84' else '+86' end) phone_country_code, coalesce(p.country_region,case when vietnam.dept_id is not null then 'VN' else 'CN' end) country_region, p.position_name,p.manager_user_id, coalesce(nullif(manager.nick_name,''),manager.user_name) manager_name, coalesce(p.employment_type,'FULL_TIME') employment_type, coalesce(p.employment_status,'ACTIVE') employment_status, p.hire_date,p.work_location,company.dept_id company_dept_id,company.dept_name company_name from sys_user u left join biz_staff_profile p on p.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_user manager on manager.user_id=p.manager_user_id and manager.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept staff_dept on staff_dept.dept_id=u.dept_id and staff_dept.del_flag='0' left join sys_dept company on company.parent_id=100 and company.del_flag='0' and (company.dept_id=staff_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(company.dept_id,staff_dept.ancestors)) left join sys_dept vietnam on vietnam.dept_name='越南meimaru公司' and vietnam.del_flag='0' and (vietnam.dept_id=staff_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(vietnam.dept_id,staff_dept.ancestors))
mapper.insert: insert into biz_staff_profile(user_id,employee_no,phone_country_code,country_region,position_name, manager_user_id,employment_type,employment_status,hire_date,work_location,create_by,create_time,update_by,update_time) values(#{userId},nullif(#{employeeNo},''),#{phoneCountryCode},#{countryRegion},nullif(#{positionName},''), #{managerUserId},#{employmentType},#{employmentStatus},#{hireDate},nullif(#{workLocation},''), #{updateBy},sysdate(),#{updateBy},sysdate()) on duplicate key update employee_no=values(employee_no),phone_country_code=values(phone_country_code), country_region=values(country_region),position_name=values(position_name),manager_user_id=values(manager_user_id), employment_type=values(employment_type),employment_status=values(employment_status),hire_date=values(hire_date), work_location=values(work_location),update_by=values(update_by),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_staff_profile where employee_no=#{employeeNo} and user_id<>#{userId}
mapper.update: update sys_dept d join sys_user u on u.user_id=d.leader_user_id set d.leader=coalesce(nullif(u.nick_name,''),u.user_name),d.phone=coalesce(u.phonenumber,''), d.email=coalesce(u.email,''),d.update_time=sysdate() where u.user_id=#{userId} and d.del_flag='0'
